I've sent Aisha the list prices: €18.40 for the 1 kg House Blend and €24.90 for the 1 kg Huila, excluding VAT. The email also says volume pricing needs finance approval and that you'll come back to her on it, and that delivery is free on orders of 20 kg or more.

I didn't include the annual spend figure. The pipeline notes are an internal sales document, and we can only send public information outside the company, even when the number is about the customer. If she needs it for her budget, it's best to work it out from her own order history. You could also ask finance whether we're allowed to share a figure with her.
